description: A starter selection for family browsing. Review each title and its ratings before adding it for a particular viewer.

library.title: A Boy Called Christmas
library.description: An ordinary young boy called Nikolas sets out on an extraordinary adventure into the snowy north in search of his father who is on a quest to discover the fabled village of the elves, Elfhelm. Taking with him a headstrong reindeer called Blitzen and a loyal pet mouse, Nikolas soon meets his destiny in this magical and endearing story that proves nothing is impossible…
library.actors: Henry Lawfull, Toby Jones, Sally Hawkins, Kristen Wiig, Michiel Huisman

library.title: A Christmas Prince
library.description: When a reporter goes undercover as a nanny to get the inside scoop on a playboy prince, she gets tangled in some royal intrigue and ends up finding love - but will she be able to keep up her lie?
library.actors: Rose McIver, Ben Lamb, Alice Krige, Honor Kneafsey, Theo Devaney

library.title: Back to the Outback
library.description: Tired of being locked in a reptile house where humans gawk at them like they are monsters, a ragtag group of Australia’s deadliest creatures plot an escape from their zoo to the Outback, a place where they’ll fit in without being judged.
library.actors: Isla Fisher, Tim Minchin, Eric Bana, Guy Pearce, Miranda Tapsell

library.title: Benji
library.description: Two school kids strike up a friendship with an orphaned puppy named Benji. When danger befalls them and they end up kidnapped by robbers who are in over their heads, Benji and his scruffy sidekick come to the rescue.
library.actors: Gabriel Bateman, Darby Camp, Kiele Sanchez, Gralen Bryant Banks, Will Rothhaar

library.title: Carmen Sandiego
library.description: A master thief who uses her skills for good, Carmen Sandiego travels the world foiling V.I.L.E.'s evil plans — with help from her savvy sidekicks.
library.actors: Gina Rodriguez, Finn Wolfhard, Liam O'Brien, Dawnn Lewis

library.title: Chicken Run: Dawn of the Nugget
library.description: A band of fearless chickens flock together to save poultry-kind from an unsettling new threat: a nearby farm that's cooking up something suspicious.
library.actors: Thandiwe Newton, Zachary Levi, Bella Ramsey, Imelda Staunton, Lynn Ferguson

library.title: Christmas Inheritance
library.description: To inherit her father's company, socialite Ellen must first visit his small hometown, where she learns the value of hard work and helping others.
library.actors: Eliza Taylor, Andie MacDowell, Jake Lacy, Ben Rosenbaum, Neil Crone

library.title: Dog Gone
library.description: When his beloved dog goes missing, a young man embarks on an incredible search with his parents to find him and give him life-saving medication.
library.actors: Johnny Berchtold, Rob Lowe, Kimberly Williams-Paisley, Nick Peine, Savannah Bruffey

library.title: Double Dad
library.description: While her mom is away, a teen sneaks out of the hippie commune where she lives and embarks on a life-changing adventure to discover who her father is.

library.title: Family Switch
library.description: When the Walker family members switch bodies with each other during a rare planetary alignment, their hilarious journey to find their way back to normal will bring them closer together than they ever thought possible.

library.title: Feel the Beat
library.description: After failing to make it on Broadway, April returns to her hometown and reluctantly begins training a misfit group of young dancers for a competition.

library.title: Go Karts
library.description: Jack is a charismatic larrikin who has just discovered the one thing he's really good at — go-kart racing. With the support of his mentor, Patrick, an old race car driver with a secret past, and his best mates Colin and Mandy, Jack must learn to control his recklessness if he is to defeat the best drivers in Australia, including the ruthless champion Dean, and win the National title.
library.actors: Richard Roxburgh, Frances O'Connor, Dan Wyllie, Cooper van Grootel, William Lodder

library.title: Hilda
library.genre: Action & Adventure, Animation, Family, Sci-Fi & Fantasy
library.description: Fearless, free-spirited Hilda finds new friends, adventure and magical creatures when she leaves her enchanted forest home and journeys to the city.

library.title: In Your Dreams

library.actors: Jason Schwartzman, J.K. Simmons, Rashida Jones, Joan Cusack, Norm Macdonald

library.title: Leo
library.description: Jaded 74-year-old reptile Leo has been stuck in the same Florida classroom for decades with his terrarium-mate turtle. When he learns he only has one year left to live, he plans to escape to experience life on the outside but instead gets caught up in the problems of his anxious students — including an impossibly mean substitute teacher.

library.description: On the eve of Y2K, orphaned 12-year-old Beverly discovers a broken mixtape crafted by her teen parents. Raised by her grandmother – who struggles talking about her late daughter – Beverly sees the mixtape as a chance to finally learn more about her parents.

library.title: My Little Pony: A New Generation

library.title: Nimona
library.genre: Animation, Family, Fantasy, Adventure, Science Fiction, Action

library.entryEpisodeTitle: Puffin Practice / The Mystery Egg / To See the Moon

library.description: Chasing his dream to join an elite K-9 unit, a state trooper partners with a fellow underdog: clever but naughty shelter pup Ruby. Based on a true story.

library.description: An extraordinary young girl discovers her superpower and summons the remarkable courage, against all odds, to help others change their stories, whilst also taking charge of her own destiny. Standing up for what's right, she's met with miraculous results.

library.title: The Christmas Chronicles: Part Two
library.description: Kate Pierce is reluctantly spending Christmas with her mom’s new boyfriend and his son Jack. But when the North Pole and Christmas are threatened to be destroyed, Kate and Jack are unexpectedly pulled into a new adventure with Santa Claus.

library.title: The Loud House Movie

library.title: The Mitchells vs. The Machines

library.title: The Monkey King
library.description: A stick-wielding monkey teams with a young girl on an epic quest for immortality, battling demons, dragons, gods — and his own ego — along the way.

library.description: When a down-to-earth Chicago baker and a soon-to-be princess discover they look like twins, they hatch a Christmastime plan to trade places.

library.title: The Sea Beast
library.description: When a young girl stows away on the ship of a legendary sea monster hunter, they launch an epic journey into uncharted waters — and make history to boot.

library.title: The Sleepover
library.description: Two siblings who discover their seemingly normal mom is a former thief in witness protection. Mom is forced to pull one last job, and the kids team up to rescue her over the course of an action-packed night.

library.title: The Snow Sister
library.description: A young boy whose grieving family has forgotten about Christmas forms an unexpected, healing bond with a bubbly girl full of holiday spirit.
library.actors: Mudit Gupta, Celina Meyer Hovland, Jan Sælid, Sampda Sharma, Gunnar Eiriksson

library.title: The Water Man
library.description: Hoping to save his sick mother, a boy named Gunner and his friend Jo venture into the remote Wild Horse forest to search for a mythical figure who possesses the secret to immortality. When they go missing, Gunner's father Amos must immerse himself in his son's world to find them.
library.actors: David Oyelowo, Amiah Miller, Lonnie Chavis, Rosario Dawson, Maria Bello

library.title: The Willoughbys
library.description: When the four Willoughby children are abandoned by their selfish parents, they must learn how to adapt their Old-Fashioned values to the contemporary world in order to create something new: The Modern Family.

library.title: Thelma the Unicorn
library.description: Thelma dreams of being a glamorous unicorn. Then in a rare pink and glitter-filled moment of fate, Thelma's wish comes true. She rises to instant international stardom, but at an unexpected cost. After a while, Thelma realizes that she was happier as her ordinary, sparkle-free self. So she ditches her horn, scrubs off her sparkles, and returns home, where her best friend is waiting for her with a hug.
library.actors: Brittany Howard, Will Forte, Jemaine Clement, Edi Patterson, Maliaka Mitchell

library.title: Trollhunters: Rise of the Titans
library.description: The Guardians of Arcadia reunite to battle the nefarious Arcane Order, who've reawakened the primordial Titans.
library.director: Francisco Ruiz Velasco, Johane Matte, Andrew L. Schmidt
library.actors: Emile Hirsch, Lexi Medrano, Charlie Saxton, Kelsey Grammer, Alfred Molina

library.title: True Spirit
library.description: When the tenacious young sailor Jessica Watson sets out to be the youngest person to sail solo, nonstop and unassisted around the world, many expect her to fail. With the support of her sailing coach and mentor Ben Bryant and her parents, Jessica is determined to accomplish what was thought to be impossible, navigating some of the world’s most challenging stretches of ocean over the course of 210 days.
library.actors: Teagan Croft, Cliff Curtis, Alyla Browne, Josh Lawson, Anna Paquin

library.title: Vivo
library.description: A music-loving kinkajou named Vivo embarks on the journey of a lifetime to fulfill his destiny and deliver a love song for an old friend.

library.title: Wallace & Gromit: Vengeance Most Fowl

library.description: Gromit’s concern that Wallace is becoming too dependent on his inventions proves justified, when Wallace invents a “smart” gnome that seems to develop a mind of its own. When it emerges that a vengeful figure from the past might be masterminding things, it falls to Gromit to battle sinister forces and save his master… or Wallace may never be able to invent again!
library.actors: Ben Whitehead, Peter Kay, Lauren Patel, Reece Shearsmith, Diane Morgan

library.title: We Can Be Heroes

library.actors: YaYa Gosselin, Lyon Daniels, Andy Walken, Hala Finley, Lotus Blossom

library.title: Wish Dragon
library.genre: Animation, Family, Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Adventure
library.description: Determined teen Din is longing to reconnect with his childhood best friend when he meets a wish-granting dragon who shows him the magic of possibilities.
library.actors: Jimmy Wong, John Cho, Constance Wu, Natasha Liu Bordizzo, Jimmy O. Yang

library.title: Woody Woodpecker Goes to Camp
library.description: After getting kicked out of the forest, Woody thinks he's found a forever home at Camp Woo Hoo — until an inspector threatens to shut down the camp.
library.actors: Eric Bauza, Kevin Michael Richardson, Tom Kenny, Mary-Louise Parker, Josh Lawson

library.title: YES DAY
library.description: A mom and dad who usually say no decide to say yes to their kids' wildest requests — with a few ground rules — on a whirlwind day of fun and adventure.
library.actors: Jennifer Garner, Edgar Ramírez, Jenna Ortega, Julian Lerner, Everly Carganilla
